notes.title: [0.2.1 Patch Note] – 1st Update (complete)
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="xsuBGwWRmOE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hello, Everyone[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all the interest and feedback you’ve given to PUMP IT UP RISE.[/p][p]Based on your suggestions, we have prepared our first official update, including new songs, the tutorial feature, and several system improvements.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Update Schedule[/b][/h2][p]• Date: [b]July 29, 2025 (Tuesday)[/b][/p][p]• Maintenance Time: [b]14:00 – [strike]16:00[/strike] 15:14 (KST)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]※ To ensure stable data saving, the following restrictions will apply before the maintenance begins.[/i][/p][list][*][p]10 minutes prior: Division Challenge will become unavailable[/p][/*][*][p]3 Minutes prior: Warm-Up/Division Station will become unavailable, and new logins will be restricted[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■ Main Update Details[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1. New Song Update (4 songs)[/b][/h3][p][b]1) Entrance (PIU Edit)[/b][/p][p]• Artist: Ice[/p][p]• BPM: 180[/p][p]• Channel: VARIETY[/p][p][/p][p][b]2) Aragami[/b][/p][p]• Artist: xi[/p][p]• BPM: 48~196[/p][p]• Channel: VARIETY[/p][p][/p][p][b]3) Transmission[/b][/p][p]• Artist: Sakuzyo[/p][p]• BPM: 100~225[/p][p]• Channel: RISE[/p][p][/p][p][b]4) Chess and Chase[/b][/p][p]• Artist: litmus* ft. CielA[/p][p]• BPM: 128[/p][p]• Channel: RISE[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Tutorial (Beta)[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601635/76dac0393361d8e6a5b0eb2ee6e0e67fc22973bb.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601635/3ba4782591ead47a9743009e36d690e4b97538ee.png"][/img][/p][p]• New users will automatically enter the tutorial on their first login.[/p][p]• Players can adjust and save their note timing through a short gameplay session.[/p][p]• The tutorial can be replayed at any time via: OPTION > GAMEPLAY > TUTORIAL[/p][p][i]※ When changing the audio playback device, proceed with the tutorial to correct the output timing again.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Other Changes[/b][/h3][p]• Makeup & Option confirm key changed: TAB → ENTER[/p][p]• ESC key added to skip the result screen[/p][p]• Display settings: 360FPS and 540FPS options added[/p][p]• Volume adjustments now provide real-time feedback (Master / BGM/ SFX)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. Bug Fixes and Stability Improvements[/b][/h3][p]• Fixed game launch errors caused by conflicts with certain NVIDIA drivers[/p][p]• Fixed an issue where FLOOR info in Division Station leaderboards was resetting[/p][p]• Fixed incorrect leaderboard registrations outside of Division channels[/p][p]• Adjusted the achievement condition for COMBO 2000[/p][p]• Fixed translation and typographical errors[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue providing a more refined service through regular updates.[/p][p]Thank you again for your continued feedback and support.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: [0.1.2 Patch Note] – Settings and Convenience Improvements (complete)
notes.content: [p]Hello, Everyone [/p][p]Thank you for all the interest and feedback you’ve given to PUMP IT UP RISE.[/p][p][/p][p]We are currently preparing version 0.1.2, which aims to improve the overall gameplay experience based on your suggestions.[/p][p][/p][p]This patch includes enhancements to timing/sync-related settings, clearer in-game explanations, and adjustments to the reward system.[/p][p]Please note that once the patch is applied, previous versions of the game will no longer be accessible. Be sure to update to the latest version before playing.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Update Version[/p][p]Version: 0.1.2[/p][p]Maintenance Date: July 17, 2025 (Thu)[/p][p]Maintenance Time: 15:00 – [strike]15:30[/strike] (15:21) (KST) *Estimated 30 minutes[/p][p]※ As the maintenance time approaches, the following restrictions will be applied to ensure stable data saving:[/p][p]• 10 minutes before maintenance: Division Challenge will become unavailable[/p][p]• 3 minutes before maintenance: Warm-Up/Division Station will become unavailable, and new logins will be restricted[/p][p][/p][p]■ Main Improvements and Changes[/p][p]1. Added Option to Toggle Miss Music Effect[/p][p]   • The low-pass filter effect on MISS judgment can now be turned on or off in the settings.[/p][p]      Location: Settings > Gameplay > \[Miss Music Effect][/p][p]   • Default setting: OFF[/p][p]2. Added Tooltips for Note Output Time / Judgement Time[/p][p]   • When hovering over “Note Output Time” and “Judgement Time” in Settings > Gameplay,[/p][p]      tooltips will now display to explain each option’s function.[/p][p]3. Unlock Requirement Display for Level-Locked Songs[/p][p]   • When selecting a locked song, a pop-up will now show the level required to unlock it.[/p][p]4. Expanded Note Output Time Range[/p][p]   • Before: -100 ~ +100[/p][p]   • After: -200 ~ +200[/p][p]5. Adjusted EXP Gain Structure in Warm-Up Station[/p][p]   • Rhythm Pass EXP and Account Level EXP can now also be earned in the Warm-Up Station,[/p][p]      equivalent to the Division Station.[/p][p]   The following conditions remain unchanged  :[/p][p]   • No EXP is awarded for broken grades (Clear Failed).[/p][p]   • Plates (FULL COMBO or higher) and BGAs (NO MISS or higher)[/p][p]      can only be unlocked through Division Station play.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Other Bug Fixes[/p][p]   • Network stability improvements[/p][p]   • Fixed some translation errors[/p][p][/p][p]This patch focuses on addressing issues that have a direct impact on gameplay.[/p][p]Additional feedback and reports from players will be reviewed and addressed through future updates.[/p][p]We will continue to listen to your feedback and improve the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]
